name: Taodock AI Image & Video
description: Discover authorized Taodock models, generate images, create and monitor video jobs, and download completed media through a local stdio MCP server.
author: Taodock

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List image, video, or text models available to the configured Taodock API key.

kind.description: Only include this model kind. Defaults to image and video models.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image with a Taodock model, consume account quota, and save the result locally.

model.description: Image model ID returned by list_models.

parameters.description: Optional model-specific request fields from the Taodock model guide.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Start an asynchronous Taodock video generation task and consume account quota.

model.description: Video model ID returned by list_models.

request.description: Video request fields from the Taodock model guide.

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Return the current state of a Taodock video generation task.

tools.name: download_video
tools.description: Download a completed Taodock video task to the configured local output directory.

wait_seconds.description: Optional time to wait for task completion before returning.

localizations.name: Taodock AI 图片与视频
localizations.description: 通过本地 stdio MCP 服务发现 Taodock 账号已授权模型，生成图片，创建并查询视频任务，以及下载生成完成的媒体文件。
